notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla's cast pipeline: the four CMSG_CAST_SPELL target shapes, CMSG_CANCEL_CAST/CHANNELLING/AURA, SMSG_CAST_RESULT, SPELL_START/GO (write-side-order SpellCastTargets, ammo block, miss list with reflect byte), SPELL_FAILED_OTHER, SPELL_DELAYED, MSG_CHANNEL_START/UPDATE, SMSG_UPDATE_AURA_DURATION, SMSG_PLAY_SPELL_VISUAL, SMSG_SPELL_UPDATE_CHAIN_TARGETS. MSUI implements nearly all of it (SpellPackets.cs parses match Benilla bit for bit, incl. the reflect tail and the no-transport-guid source location), with two concrete divergences.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: SMSG_SPELL_FAILURE (listed by the mechanical pre-pass) is not a real gap: Benilla documents it as never constructed by vmangos and parses it nowhere; observer cancel notices ride SMSG_SPELL_FAILED_OTHER, which MSUI handles.
